claim: ViT-L/14 has a moderate positive CDS
ViT-L/14 has the highest full-context accuracy
ViT-B/32 accuracy is non-monotonic (peak at an intermediate crop, ultra-tight above full)
BioCLIP has the lowest Context Robustness (CR < 50 %)
ViT-B/32 is the most robust to wrong backgrounds (highest CR)
Desert is the least disruptive habitat, urban/aquatic the most (majority of models)
Wildlife prompt improves ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 over neutral
'Scientific specimen' is the worst prompt for every model
ViT-B/32 has the highest Prompt Sensitivity
ViT-L/14 is the most prompt-stable model
BioCLIP has the largest confidence-accuracy gap at ultra-tight crops
All models exceed chance on background-only images
Dog has a negative CDS for all three models
BioCLIP drops to 0 % for opossum and rodent without context
ViT-B/32 has a negative CDS for ~half of the species (paper: 9 of 17)
Car CDS = 0 for every model ('validates the method')
